# God of Prompt

> > God of Prompt: Master AI prompt engineering with expert guides, ready-to-use ChatGPT prompts, and workflow automation tools for business and creative applications.

God of Prompt is a comprehensive platform offering prompt engineering resources, tutorials, and automation bundles for ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Grok, and other AI tools. Founded by prompt engineering experts Robert Youssef and Alex Prompter, the platform helps users master AI workflows for business automation, content creation, and creative applications.
